body.purpose: Every piece of UI text — no separate display face.

mono.purpose: Label pills (key=value) and ledger timestamps only.

shadows.name: node-card-hover
shadows.purpose: The one accepted elevation exception: a subtle lift on node-card hover, paired with a 1px translateY. Never used at rest.

motion.name: interaction-transition
motion.purpose: Short transitions on hover/focus/border-color/background-color across buttons, tabs, inputs, table rows, pagination, node cards.

motion.name: htmx-settle-fade
motion.value: opacity 0.2s ease, paired with hx-swap settle:200ms
motion.purpose: Swapped content (auto-refresh, filters, pagination) fades in via .htmx-settling{opacity:0} instead of popping in instantly.

components.name: Status Label — Firing
components.description: Solid-color status label, no icon or animation, matching Alertmanager's own flat status rendering.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ffffff; } .ds-status-firing { background: #d9534f; }

components.name: Status Label — Resolved
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ffffff; } .ds-status-resolved { background: #5cb85c; }

components.name: Navbar Tab
components.description: Dark-navbar nav item; active tab gets an orange bottom border.
components.css: .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 14px; height: 50px; color: #d7d9dd; font-size: 13px; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #ffffff; background: #32363f; } .ds-tab-active { color: #ffffff; border-bottom-color: #e6522c; background: #32363f; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; background: #e6522c; border: 1px solid #c7431f; color: #ffffff; padding: 9px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #c7431f; }

components.name: Label Pill
components.description: Monospace key=value tag matching Alertmanager's own label rendering.
components.css: .ds-label-pill { font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; background: #f7f7f9; border: 1px solid #dddddd; border-radius: 3px; padding: 2px 7px; font-size: 12px; color: #333333; } .ds-label-pill b { font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: Navbar icon button switching data-theme on <html> between light and dark, persisted to localStorage. Shows a sun icon when light is active, moon when dark is active.
components.html: <button class="ds-theme-toggle" aria-label="Toggle dark mode"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M4.9 4.9l1.4 1.4M17.7 17.7l1.4 1.4M2 12h2M20 12h2M4.9 19.1l1.4-1.4M17.7 6.3l1.4-1.4"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: none; border: none; color: #d7d9dd; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 4px; transition: color 0.12s ease, background-color 0.12s ease; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { color: #ffffff; background: #32363f; }

narrative.overview: Promhis's dashboard deliberately mirrors the real Prometheus/Alertmanager web UI: a dark top navbar carrying the Prometheus flame-orange accent, a white (or dark-mode) content area, and flat Bootstrap-era components (bordered panels, striped tables, solid-color status/severity labels). This replaces an earlier bespoke 'brass fire-alarm annunciator' direction — the user explicitly rejected that look and asked for the actual ecosystem's own visual language instead, so this is a full redesign, not a refinement. The user then asked for modern polish on top of that flat core: short transitions on every interactive element, a fade-in on htmx-swapped content, and a dark/light theme toggle (which the real Alertmanager UI also has, reinforcing rather than undermining authenticity). The goal is instant familiarity for anyone who has ever looked at Prometheus or Alertmanager, with motion that is restrained and functional rather than decorative.
keyCharacteristics: Dark navbar (#1f2229, unchanged across themes) with Prometheus flame-orange (#e6522c) as the only strong accent color.
Status and severity are shown as solid-color Bootstrap-style labels — flat rectangles, no dots, no state-change animation.
System font stack only — no self-hosted webfonts.
Flat panels at rest: 1px border, alt-background header bar, no shadows, no gradients, no glow — except a subtle hover lift on node cards.
Dark/light theme toggle in the navbar, persisted to localStorage, defaulting to OS preference.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Orange appears in exactly three places (flame mark, active-tab underline, primary buttons/chart bars) and nowhere else, in both themes.

rules.name: The No-Webfont Rule
rules.body: Typography is the platform's own sans stack. No @font-face, no Google Fonts import.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing carries a shadow by default. A shadow may only appear as a hover/interaction response (currently just the node-card lift), never as resting-state decoration.

dos: Do keep orange limited to the flame mark, active-tab underline, and primary buttons/chart accents, in both themes.
Do pair every status/severity color with its text label — never color alone.
Do keep elevation flat at rest; a shadow may only appear as a hover response.
Do use the system font stack; don't load a custom webfont.
Do use short (0.1-0.2s) transitions on hover/focus/htmx-swap.
donts: Don't bring back the bespoke signature animation (flap-drop/overshoot) from the earlier annunciator direction.
Don't add colored borders thicker than 1px to cards, rows, or labels.
Don't hardcode a neutral color outside the theme-aware tokens.
